game.title: Watch Dogs
game.blurb: Open-world action-adventure in which hacker Aiden Pearce turns the ctOS network of Chicago against his enemies, from Ubisoft Montreal, released 2014-05-27. RAWG average playtime: 16 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Five acts of Aiden's hunt through Chicago. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Fixer Contracts, Crime and Investigations
chapters.summary: Fixer contracts, gang hideouts, criminal convoys, the Crime Detection System and the four investigations.

chapters.title: ctOS, City Games and Chicago Extras
chapters.summary: ctOS Towers and Breaches, Privacy Invasions, City Games, hotspots, burner phones, SongSneak and the drinking game.

chapters.title: Combat, Driving and Hacking Skills
chapters.summary: Takedowns, Focus, IEDs, police chases and scans, shooting tyres, tagging enemies and the skill tree.

chapters.title: Online Hacking, Tailing and Races
chapters.summary: Invading and observing other players, online races and being tailed yourself.

chapters.title: Bad Blood (DLC, played as T-Bone)
chapters.summary: The T-Bone campaign: three acts, contracts, driving and co-op missions, and side investigations.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has the guide at completion stage 2, but the only written walkthrough subpage is "Prologue and Intro" (about 3,200 characters); the Walkthrough page itself (about 1,700 characters) links to no act pages, and Side Missions and Collectables is linked from the contents but not written. Gameplay, Downloadable Content (about 470 characters) and Table of Contents also exist. That is not a real guide, so it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and the route stays original. watchdogs.fandom.com answers the API, with about 138 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 49 Steam achievements is hidden. The Steam schema name is "Watch_Dogs". The 10 achievements whose names start with "T-Bone:" were placed in the Bad Blood chapter; the DLC name comes from RAWG's search results ("Watch Dogs: Bad Blood") and the Fandom page of that name, which links to "Raymond "T-Bone" Kenney". Their "Complete Act 1" to "Act 3" descriptions repeat the base game's wording, so they were sorted by name, not description.
